resources.string: Yingiza olunaku lwa Hijri okufuna Arafah, An-Nahr n’ennaku za Tashreeq
Yingiza olunaku lwa Hijri olabe Arafah, An-Nahr n’ennaku za Tashreeq
Yingiza olunaku lwa Hijri olutuufu. Omwaka okuva mu 1300 okutuuka mu 1600, omwezi okuva ku 1 okutuuka ku 12, olunaku okuva ku 1 okutuuka ku 30.

Yingiza olunaku lwonna olwa Hijri (oba kuuma olunaku oluliwo kati) okufuna amangu ddala ennaku za Hijja ez’omwaka gwayo: olunaku lwa Arafah (9 Dhul-Hijjah), olunaku lwa An-Nahr (10 Dhul-Hijjah) n’ennaku za Tashreeq (11, 12 ne 13 Dhul-Hijjah), buli emu n’ekyenkanankana kyayo ekya Gregorian n’ekifo kyayo okusinziira ku lunaku lwo.
Empagi esinga obunene: yimirira ku Arafah okuva oluvannyuma lw’emisana okutuusa enjuba lw’egwa, nga mwegayirira nnyo, takbir ne tahlil. Nabbi (PBUH) yagamba nti: “Hijja ye Arafah.”
Eid al-Adha: okukuba Jamarat al-Aqabah amayinja n’amayinja musanvu, okuwaayo ssaddaaka, okusenya oba okusala, olwo okole Tawaf al-Ifadah ne Sai.
Okumanyisibwa okwa buli lunaku nga kukujjukiza omukolo ogugendereddwa mu kiseera kyagwo mu nnaku za Hijja (8–13 Dhul-Hijjah) .

Sunnah y\'olunaku luno: yingira mu ihram, ogende e Mina omaleyo ekiro, nga oddiŋŋana Talbiyah "Labbayk Allahumma labbayk", era osaalire eyo ng\'ofunze awatali kugatta.
Amayinja amayinja Jamarat essatu oluvannyuma lw’emisana: entono, olwo eya wakati, olwo ennene, amayinja musanvu buli limu ng’oyogera takbir, nga yeegayirira oluvannyuma lw’obutono n’obw’omu makkati.
Ddamu okukuba amayinja Jamarat essatu oluvannyuma lw’emisana nga eggulo. Oyo yenna ayagala okwanguya ayinza okuva e Mina ng’enjuba tennagwa; buli asigala asula n’akuba amayinja ku lunaku olw’okusatu.
Ennaku za Tashreeq: olunaku olwokubiri (12 Dhul-Hijjah) .
Amayinja amayinja Jamarat essatu oluvannyuma lw’emisana, olwo Hijja okome ne Tawaf y’okusiibula ng’ova e Makkah. Allah akkirize Hijja yo.
Ennaku za Tashreeq: olunaku olwokusatu (13 Dhul-Hijjah) .

Ekiwandiiko ekijjuvu ekikwata ku Hijja ne Umrah: ennyonyola n’ensala, ebika by’emikolo, mawaqit, emikolo mutendera ku mutendera n’amagezi gaabwe n’ebyo eby’okwogera ku buli siteegi, ebikugira ihram, n’okwegayirira. Londa ekitundu ky’oyagala okunoonyerezaako.

Nabbi صلى الله عليه وسلم yagamba nti: “Allah alina amannya kyenda mu mwenda, ekikumi nga kikendeddeko limu;oyo alibala aliyingira ejjana.” Koona ku linnya lyonna okusoma ennyonyola yaalyo mu bujjuvu, amakulu n’obujulizi okuva mu Quran.
